result.summary: Found 1 major accessibility/styling issue where a background graphic reduces text readability in the promotional banner.

issues.description: In the top promotional green banner, the semi-transparent dark green circular graphic overlaps the text '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10', creating low contrast between the white text and the dark green overlapping area, making parts of the text ('you', '€10') hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the banner's background graphic to avoid overlapping with text elements, or increase text contrast (e.g., bold the text, lighten the overlapping graphic area, or reposition the text to an unobscured section of the banner).
